anomalies.observed: R4 is a 0 Ω resistor directly connecting the two servo signal pins: R4.1 is on Net-(J11-Pin_3) and R4.2 is on Net-(J7-Pin_3).
anomalies.expected: In PWM mode the two servo headers must have independent signal lines. The specification says they are bridged only in serial mode by populating R13/R14; they should not be permanently connected through R4.

evidence.quote: PWM mode: two independent PWM channels
Serial mode ... Short R13, R14 ... bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together

anomalies.impact: The servo signal outputs are electrically tied together, so PWM mode cannot independently control the two servos; the shared signal can also cause contention between their GPIO drivers.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows a 0 Ω link directly joining the two servo signal pins. This contradicts the specified independent PWM channels and makes the signal paths shared regardless of the intended serial-mode jumper selection.
